subject.title: feat(cron): serve cron run history from the task ledger

question: Should this PR include the migration and retention safety work before flipping cron history reads, or should the authority/read flip be deferred to the follow-up phase?
rationale: The current split makes task-ledger reads depend on safety work assigned to a later PR, so maintainers must choose a release staging boundary that preserves shipped history and startup behavior.

options.title: Include safety before read flip
options.body: Add mirror reconciliation, explicit durable migration, and cron-specific ledger retention to this PR before making task_runs authoritative.

options.title: Defer the authority flip
options.body: Keep this PR to full-fidelity ledger writes and schema support, then switch reads only after the follow-up migration and retention work lands.

recommendation.title: Include safety before read flip
recommendation.body: Add mirror reconciliation, explicit durable migration, and cron-specific ledger retention to this PR before making task_runs authoritative.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the canonical design issue, proposed the two-PR staging, and has recent ownership history across the affected cron surfaces.
